description: Defines the PlayerProvider class in a Flutter app, managing audiobook playback state including current book, position, playback status, and persistence.

classes.name: PlayerProvider
classes.description: A provider that manages the state of audiobook playback, including current book, position, and playback status, with persistence features.

methods.name: setBook
methods.description: Sets the current audiobook and loads its progress.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the current audiobook.

methods.name: _loadProgress
methods.description: Loads saved progress for the current audiobook.

methods.name: saveProgress
methods.description: Saves the current playback position for the current audiobook.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the current position during UI interactions.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Advances playback by one second if playing.
